title: Provenance
description: Provenance fragment per OBJECT-MODEL.md §9. Required on builtin and community physical values; recommended on user_local and project. Host schemas enforce origin-conditional requirement.

source_type.description: Category of the source. 'standard' = official body (NIST, IEC, IPC). 'reference' = textbook / handbook. 'datasheet' = manufacturer datasheet. 'community' = community pack. 'user_supplied' = user typed it.

title.description: Short label describing what this value is. E.g., 'Copper resistivity, annealed, at 20 C'.

citation.description: The specific citation. May include multiple sources separated by semicolons (transitional convention; array form is a future schema enhancement).

date_accessed.description: Optional ISO 8601 date the source was last verified. Recommended for live web sources.

confidence.description: How confident the author is in the value. Drops a tier when only one source exists; drops further when sources disagree.

notes.description: Optional human notes — e.g., conditions, caveats, comparison to other sources.
